Create Employee.name: Create Employee
Create Employee.title: Add your employees
Create Employee.description: The people you manage, with their joining date, department and reporting manager. See [Employee](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/employee).

Complete Recruitment Onboarding.name: Complete Recruitment Onboarding
Complete Recruitment Onboarding.title: Hire your first employee
Complete Recruitment Onboarding.description: Open a job, add an applicant and make them an offer.

Complete Tenure Onboarding.name: Complete Tenure Onboarding
Complete Tenure Onboarding.title: Welcome and see off employees
Complete Tenure Onboarding.description: Track the joining tasks for a new hire and the exit tasks when someone leaves.

Complete Shift and Attendance Onboarding.name: Complete Shift and Attendance Onboarding
Complete Shift and Attendance Onboarding.title: Track attendance and shifts
Complete Shift and Attendance Onboarding.description: Define a shift, put an employee on it and mark their attendance.

Complete Leaves Onboarding.name: Complete Leaves Onboarding
Complete Leaves Onboarding.title: Manage time off
Complete Leaves Onboarding.description: Set your holidays and leave types, give leave and approve a request.

Complete Expenses Onboarding.name: Complete Expenses Onboarding
Complete Expenses Onboarding.title: Settle employee expenses
Complete Expenses Onboarding.description: Approve an expense claim and pay the employee back.

Complete Payroll Onboarding.name: Complete Payroll Onboarding
Complete Payroll Onboarding.title: Run your first payroll
Complete Payroll Onboarding.description: Build a salary structure, assign it and run payroll.

Complete Tax and Benefits Onboarding.name: Complete Tax and Benefits Onboarding
Complete Tax and Benefits Onboarding.title: Deduct the right tax
Complete Tax and Benefits Onboarding.description: Set the payroll period and tax slabs, and record what employees declare.

Complete Performance Onboarding.name: Complete Performance Onboarding
Complete Performance Onboarding.title: Review performance
Complete Performance Onboarding.description: Set up what employees are measured on and run an appraisal cycle.

Create Employee Onboarding Template.name: Create Employee Onboarding Template
Create Employee Onboarding Template.title: Write an onboarding checklist
Create Employee Onboarding Template.description: The tasks to finish when someone joins, reused for every new hire. See [Employee Onboarding](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/employee-onboarding).

Create Employee Onboarding.name: Create Employee Onboarding
Create Employee Onboarding.title: Onboard a new hire
Create Employee Onboarding.description: Tracks the joining tasks for one new employee. Submit it once they are done. See [Employee Onboarding](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/employee-onboarding).

Create Employee Separation.name: Create Employee Separation
Create Employee Separation.title: Handle an exit
Create Employee Separation.description: Tracks the exit tasks when an employee leaves. Submit it once they are done. See [Employee Separation](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/employee-separation).

Create Training Program.name: Create Training Program
Create Training Program.title: Plan a training program
Create Training Program.description: A course you run for employees, with its trainer and what it covers. See [Training Program](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/training-program).

Create Training Event.name: Create Training Event
Create Training Event.title: Schedule a training
Create Training Event.description: A session of a training program and the employees attending it. See [Training Event](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/training-event).

View Employee Analytics.name: View Employee Analytics
View Employee Analytics.title: Look at your workforce
View Employee Analytics.description: Employees by branch, department, designation or grade.
View Employee Analytics.report_description: Employees by branch, department, designation or grade.

Chart of Accounts.name: Chart of Accounts
Chart of Accounts.title: Review your chart of accounts
Chart of Accounts.description: We set up a standard chart of accounts for your country. See how your accounts are grouped, and rename or add any to match how you report. See [Chart of Accounts](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/chart-of-accounts).

Review Taxes.name: Review Taxes
Review Taxes.title: Review your taxes
Review Taxes.description: The taxes that fill in on every invoice. We added your country's where we had them; check the rates match what you charge. Purchase taxes live in [Purchase Taxes and Charges Template](/desk/purchase-taxes-and-charges-template). See [Setting Up Taxes](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/setting-up-taxes).
Review Taxes.action_label: Open Sales Taxes and Charges Template

Add Bank Account.name: Add Bank Account
Add Bank Account.title: Add the bank account you use
Add Bank Account.description: The account your customers pay into and you pay from, linked to its account in your chart of accounts. See [Bank Account](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/bank-account).

Create Accounting Purchase Invoice.name: Create Accounting Purchase Invoice
Create Accounting Purchase Invoice.title: Enter a supplier's bill
Create Accounting Purchase Invoice.description: It posts the expense, and what you owe the supplier, to your ledger. See [Purchase Invoice](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/purchase-invoice).

Create Journal Entry.name: Create Journal Entry
Create Journal Entry.title: Post a journal entry
Create Journal Entry.description: For anything that isn't an invoice or a payment: accruals, depreciation, or fixing a mistake. See [Journal Entry](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/journal-entry).

Open Banking.name: Open Banking
Open Banking.title: Match your bank statement
Open Banking.description: Import a statement from your bank and pair each line with a payment, so your books agree with it. See [Bank Reconciliation](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/bank-reconciliation).

View General Ledger.name: View General Ledger
View General Ledger.title: Trace every posting
View General Ledger.description: Every posting from your invoices and payments, with its debit and credit. See [General Ledger](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/general-ledger).
View General Ledger.report_description: Every posting, with its debit and credit.

View Profit and Loss.name: View Profit and Loss
View Profit and Loss.title: Check your profit
View Profit and Loss.description: Income against expenses for any period, built from every invoice and payment you have recorded.
View Profit and Loss.report_description: Income against expenses, from every invoice and payment.

View Balance Sheet.name: View Balance Sheet
View Balance Sheet.title: Know what you own and owe
View Balance Sheet.description: Assets, liabilities and equity on any date, straight from your ledger. See [Balance Sheet](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/balance-sheet).
View Balance Sheet.report_description: Assets, liabilities and equity on any date.

Create Job Opening.name: Create Job Opening
Create Job Opening.title: Open a job
Create Job Opening.description: A role you are hiring for, which you can publish on your job portal. See [Job Opening](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/job-opening).

Create Job Applicant.name: Create Job Applicant
Create Job Applicant.title: Add an applicant
Create Job Applicant.description: Someone who applied for a job opening. Applications from the job portal arrive here. See [Job Applicant](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/job-applicant).

Create Interview.name: Create Interview
Create Interview.title: Schedule an interview
Create Interview.description: An interview round with the applicant and the people interviewing them. See [Interview](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/interview).

Create Job Offer.name: Create Job Offer
Create Job Offer.title: Make an offer
Create Job Offer.description: The terms you offer the applicant. Submit it once they accept. See [Job Offer](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/job-offer).

Create Appointment Letter.name: Create Appointment Letter
Create Appointment Letter.title: Send an appointment letter
Create Appointment Letter.description: The formal letter that confirms the role and its terms. See [Appointment Letter](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/appointment-letter).

View Recruitment Analytics.name: View Recruitment Analytics
View Recruitment Analytics.title: Track hiring against your plan
View Recruitment Analytics.description: Openings, applicants and offers for each designation in a staffing plan.
View Recruitment Analytics.report_description: Openings, applicants and offers for each designation in a staffing plan.

Create Shift Type.name: Create Shift Type
Create Shift Type.title: Define a shift
Create Shift Type.description: A shift's working hours and the rules for marking attendance from check-ins. See [Shift Type](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/shift-type).

Create Shift Assignment.name: Create Shift Assignment
Create Shift Assignment.title: Assign a shift
Create Shift Assignment.description: Puts an employee on a shift from a date. See [Shift Assignment](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/shift-assignment).

Create Employee Checkin.name: Create Employee Checkin
Create Employee Checkin.title: Record a check-in
Create Employee Checkin.description: A punch from a biometric device or the mobile app. Auto attendance turns these into attendance. See [Employee Checkin](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/employee-checkin).

Create Attendance.name: Create Attendance
Create Attendance.title: Mark attendance
Create Attendance.description: Whether an employee was present, absent or on leave on a day. See [Attendance](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/attendance).

Create Attendance Request.name: Create Attendance Request
Create Attendance Request.title: Request attendance
Create Attendance Request.description: An employee's request to be marked present for days on duty or working from home. See [Attendance Request](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/attendance-request).

View Monthly Attendance Sheet.name: View Monthly Attendance Sheet
View Monthly Attendance Sheet.title: Check the month's attendance
View Monthly Attendance Sheet.description: Each employee's attendance for every day of the month.
View Monthly Attendance Sheet.report_description: Each employee's attendance for every day of the month.

Create Supplier.name: Create Supplier
Create Supplier.title: Add a supplier
Create Supplier.description: A business or person you buy from. See [Supplier](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/supplier).

Create Buying Item.name: Create Buying Item
Create Buying Item.title: Add an item you buy
Create Buying Item.description: Goods or services you buy from suppliers. See [Item](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/item).

Create Supplier Quotation.name: Create Supplier Quotation
Create Supplier Quotation.title: Record a supplier's quote
Create Supplier Quotation.description: Note down a price a supplier offered, so you can compare suppliers before you order. See [Supplier Quotation](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/supplier-quotation).

Create Purchase Order.name: Create Purchase Order
Create Purchase Order.title: Place a purchase order
Create Purchase Order.description: Order from the supplier. When the goods arrive, receive them and record the bill from the order itself. See [Purchase Order](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/purchase-order).

Create Purchase Invoice.name: Create Purchase Invoice
Create Purchase Invoice.title: Enter their bill
Create Purchase Invoice.description: The bill your supplier sent, so you know what you owe and when it is due. See [Purchase Invoice](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/purchase-invoice).

Pay Supplier.name: Pay Supplier
Pay Supplier.title: Pay your supplier
Pay Supplier.description: It clears their bill and takes the money out of your bank or cash account. See [Payment Entry](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/payment-entry).

View Accounts Payable.name: View Accounts Payable
View Accounts Payable.title: Check what you owe
View Accounts Payable.description: Who you owe, how much, and when each bill is due.
View Accounts Payable.report_description: Who you owe, how much, and when it is due.

View Purchase Order Analysis.name: View Purchase Order Analysis
View Purchase Order Analysis.title: Track your orders
View Purchase Order Analysis.description: What you ordered, what has arrived, and what is still to come.
View Purchase Order Analysis.report_description: What you ordered, what arrived and what is still to come.

Create Holiday List.name: Create Holiday List
Create Holiday List.title: Set your holidays
Create Holiday List.description: The weekly offs and public holidays your employees get. See [Holiday List](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/holiday-list).

Create Leave Type.name: Create Leave Type
Create Leave Type.title: Add a leave type
Create Leave Type.description: A kind of leave, such as casual or sick, and its rules. See [Leave Type](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/leave-type).

Create Leave Policy.name: Create Leave Policy
Create Leave Policy.title: Bundle leave types into a policy
Create Leave Policy.description: How many days of each leave type an employee gets in a year. See [Leave Policy](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/leave-policy).

Create Leave Allocation.name: Create Leave Allocation
Create Leave Allocation.title: Give an employee leave
Create Leave Allocation.description: The days an employee can take of a leave type in a period. See [Leave Allocation](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/leave-allocation).

Create Leave Application.name: Create Leave Application
Create Leave Application.title: Approve a leave request
Create Leave Application.description: An employee's request for time off. Their leave approver approves and submits it. See [Leave Application](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/leave-application).

View Employee Leave Balance.name: View Employee Leave Balance
View Employee Leave Balance.title: Check leave balances
View Employee Leave Balance.description: How much of each leave type every employee has left.
View Employee Leave Balance.report_description: How much of each leave type every employee has left.

Create Employee Advance.name: Create Employee Advance
Create Employee Advance.title: Give an employee an advance
Create Employee Advance.description: Money paid before the expense, settled later against the claim. See [Employee Advance](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/employee-advance).

Create Expense Claim.name: Create Expense Claim
Create Expense Claim.title: Approve an expense claim
Create Expense Claim.description: An employee's claim for money they spent on work. The expense approver approves and submits it. See [Expense Claim](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/expense-claim).

Pay Expense Claim.name: Pay Expense Claim
Pay Expense Claim.title: Pay the employee back
Pay Expense Claim.description: Pick an approved claim from the list this opens and use Create > Payment on it. The payment is then linked to the claim and marks it paid. See [Expense Claim](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/expense-claim#payment-for-expense-claim).

Create Travel Request.name: Create Travel Request
Create Travel Request.title: Plan a work trip
Create Travel Request.description: Approval and funding for a work trip before it happens. See [Travel Request](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/travel-request).

View Unpaid Expense Claim.name: View Unpaid Expense Claim
View Unpaid Expense Claim.title: See what is still owed
View Unpaid Expense Claim.description: Approved claims that have not been paid back yet.
View Unpaid Expense Claim.report_description: Approved claims that have not been paid back yet.

Setup Warehouse.name: Setup Warehouse
Setup Warehouse.title: Review your warehouses
Setup Warehouse.description: We created a few to start with. Rename them, or add the places you actually keep stock. See [Warehouse](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/warehouse).

Create Item.name: Create Item
Create Item.title: Add an item you stock
Create Item.description: Anything you keep on shelves and count. See [Item](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/item).

Create Opening Stock.name: Create Opening Stock
Create Opening Stock.title: Enter the stock you have today
Create Opening Stock.description: How much of each item is on your shelves, and what it is worth. From here, every receipt and delivery keeps it up to date. See [Stock Reconciliation](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/stock-reconciliation).

Create Purchase Receipt.name: Create Purchase Receipt
Create Purchase Receipt.title: Receive goods from a supplier
Create Purchase Receipt.description: Stock goes up in the warehouse you receive into, and the bill can be made from the receipt. See [Purchase Receipt](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/purchase-receipt).

Create Delivery Note.name: Create Delivery Note
Create Delivery Note.title: Ship to a customer
Create Delivery Note.description: Stock goes down as the goods leave, and the invoice can be made from the delivery. See [Delivery Note](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/delivery-note).

Move Stock.name: Move Stock
Move Stock.title: Move stock between warehouses
Move Stock.description: From the store to the shop floor, or between branches. See [Stock Entry](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/stock-entry).

View Stock Ledger.name: View Stock Ledger
View Stock Ledger.title: Follow every movement
View Stock Ledger.description: Every movement of every item, in and out, with the balance after each. See [Stock Ledger](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/stock-ledger).
View Stock Ledger.report_description: Every movement of every item, in and out.

View Stock Balance Report.name: View Stock Balance Report
View Stock Balance Report.title: Check your stock levels
View Stock Balance Report.description: What you have in each warehouse, and what it is worth.
View Stock Balance Report.report_description: What you have in each warehouse, and what it is worth.

Create Asset Category.name: Create Asset Category
Create Asset Category.title: Set up an asset category
Create Asset Category.description: Computers, vehicles, furniture: how each kind depreciates, and which accounts it posts to. See [Asset Category](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/asset-category).

Create Asset Item.name: Create Asset Item
Create Asset Item.title: Add an asset item
Create Asset Item.description: The kind of thing you own, marked as a fixed asset. See [Item](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/item).

Create Existing Asset.name: Create Existing Asset
Create Existing Asset.title: Record an asset you already own
Create Existing Asset.description: Something you bought before using ERPNext, with what you paid, where it is, and how much has already depreciated. See [Asset](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/asset).

View Asset Depreciation.name: View Asset Depreciation
View Asset Depreciation.title: Check its depreciation
View Asset Depreciation.description: Depreciation is posted on schedule, asset by asset, without a journal entry from you. See [Depreciation](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/asset-depreciation).
View Asset Depreciation.report_description: Every depreciation posted, asset by asset.

Create Asset Movement.name: Create Asset Movement
Create Asset Movement.title: Hand it to a person or place
Create Asset Movement.description: Record who has it and where it is, so you always know. See [Asset Movement](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/asset-movement).

Create Asset Maintenance.name: Create Asset Maintenance
Create Asset Maintenance.title: Schedule its upkeep
Create Asset Maintenance.description: Servicing, inspections and calibration, with reminders to the team doing it. See [Asset Maintenance](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/asset-maintenance).

View Fixed Asset Register.name: View Fixed Asset Register
View Fixed Asset Register.title: See everything you own
View Fixed Asset Register.description: What you own, where it is, and what it is worth today.
View Fixed Asset Register.report_description: What you own, where it is, and what it is worth today.

Create KRA.name: Create KRA
Create KRA.title: Add a key result area
Create KRA.description: An area an employee is measured on, such as quality or delivery. See [Appraisal Template](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/appraisal-template).

Create Appraisal Template.name: Create Appraisal Template
Create Appraisal Template.title: Build an appraisal template
Create Appraisal Template.description: The KRAs and rating criteria for a role, with their weightage. See [Appraisal Template](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/appraisal-template).

Create Appraisal Cycle.name: Create Appraisal Cycle
Create Appraisal Cycle.title: Start an appraisal cycle
Create Appraisal Cycle.description: The review period, and the employees and templates in it. See [Appraisal Cycle](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/appraisal-cycle).

Create Appraisal.name: Create Appraisal
Create Appraisal.title: Appraise an employee
Create Appraisal.description: One employee's ratings for a cycle. The cycle can create these for everyone in it. See [Appraisal](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/appraisal).

Create Goal.name: Create Goal
Create Goal.title: Set a goal
Create Goal.description: A measurable target for an employee, tracked against a KRA. See [Goal](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/goal).

Create Employee Performance Feedback.name: Create Employee Performance Feedback
Create Employee Performance Feedback.title: Give feedback
Create Employee Performance Feedback.description: A reviewer's ratings and comments on an employee for the cycle. See [Employee Performance Feedback](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/employee-performance-feedback).

View Appraisal Overview.name: View Appraisal Overview
View Appraisal Overview.title: Compare scores across a cycle
View Appraisal Overview.description: Each employee's goal, feedback and self appraisal scores in a cycle.
View Appraisal Overview.report_description: Each employee's goal, feedback and self appraisal scores in a cycle.

Create Raw Materials.name: Create Raw Materials
Create Raw Materials.title: Add a raw material
Create Raw Materials.description: Something you use to make your products, kept in the Raw Material group. See [Item](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/item).

Create Finished Goods.name: Create Finished Goods
Create Finished Goods.title: Add a product you make
Create Finished Goods.description: What comes out at the end of production, kept in the Products group. See [Item](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/item).

Create Bill of Materials.name: Create Bill of Materials
Create Bill of Materials.title: Write its bill of materials
Create Bill of Materials.description:
The raw materials, and how much of each, that go into one unit of your product. Submit it to use it in production. See [BOM](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/bill-of-materials).

Sending some of the work to a supplier? See [Subcontracting](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/subcontracting).

Create Work Order.name: Create Work Order
Create Work Order.title: Plan a work order
Create Work Order.description: Decide how many to make. The raw materials you need are worked out from the BOM. See [Work Order](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/work-order).

Finish Work Order.name: Finish Work Order
Finish Work Order.title: Finish making it
Finish Work Order.description: Raw materials come out of stock and the finished products go in. From the work order, **Finish** fills this in for you. See [Stock Entry](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/stock-entry).

Create Production Plan.name: Create Production Plan
Create Production Plan.title: Plan production from your orders
Create Production Plan.description: Pull in open sales orders and work out what to make, and what to buy, to fill them.

View Work Order Summary Report.name: View Work Order Summary Report
View Work Order Summary Report.title: See how production is going
View Work Order Summary Report.description: Every work order, how far along it is, and what is running late. See [Work Order Summary](https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/work-order-summary).
View Work Order Summary Report.report_description: Every work order, how far along it is, and what is late.

Create Salary Component.name: Create Salary Component
Create Salary Component.title: Add a salary component
Create Salary Component.description: An earning or deduction on the salary slip, such as Basic or Provident Fund. See [Salary Component](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/salary-component).

Create Salary Structure.name: Create Salary Structure
Create Salary Structure.title: Build a salary structure
Create Salary Structure.description: The earnings and deductions that make up a salary, and how each is calculated. See [Salary Structure](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/salary-structure).

Create Salary Structure Assignment.name: Create Salary Structure Assignment
Create Salary Structure Assignment.title: Assign it to an employee
Create Salary Structure Assignment.description: Puts an employee on a salary structure with their base pay from a date. See [Salary Structure Assignment](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/salary-structure-assignment).

Create Payroll Entry.name: Create Payroll Entry
Create Payroll Entry.title: Run payroll
Create Payroll Entry.description: Creates salary slips for everyone in a period and books the salary. See [Payroll Entry](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/payroll-entry).

Create Additional Salary.name: Create Additional Salary
Create Additional Salary.title: Pay a one-off amount
Create Additional Salary.description: A bonus, arrear or deduction for one payroll period. See [Additional Salary](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/additional-salary).

View Salary Register.name: View Salary Register
View Salary Register.title: Review the salary register
View Salary Register.description: Every salary slip in a period, component by component.
View Salary Register.report_description: Every salary slip in a period, component by component.

Create Payroll Period.name: Create Payroll Period
Create Payroll Period.title: Set your payroll period
Create Payroll Period.description: The financial year that tax is calculated over. See [Payroll Period](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/payroll-period).

Create Income Tax Slab.name: Create Income Tax Slab
Create Income Tax Slab.title: Add income tax slabs
Create Income Tax Slab.description: The tax rate for each range of income. See [Income Tax Slab](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/income-tax-slab).

Create Employee Tax Exemption Declaratio.name: Create Employee Tax Exemption Declaration
Create Employee Tax Exemption Declaratio.title: Declare tax exemptions
Create Employee Tax Exemption Declaratio.description: The investments and expenses an employee plans to claim against tax. See [Employee Tax Exemption Declaration](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/employee-tax-exemption-declaration).

Create Employee Tax Exemption Proof Subm.name: Create Employee Tax Exemption Proof Submission
Create Employee Tax Exemption Proof Subm.title: Submit proof of exemptions
Create Employee Tax Exemption Proof Subm.description: Proof of what was declared, so the exemption counts in the final tax. See [Employee Tax Exemption Proof Submission](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/employee-tax-exemption-proof-submission).

Create Employee Benefit Application.name: Create Employee Benefit Application
Create Employee Benefit Application.title: Choose flexible benefits
Create Employee Benefit Application.description: How an employee splits their flexible benefit amount across components. See [Employee Benefit Application](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/employee-benefit-application).

Create Gratuity Rule.name: Create Gratuity Rule
Create Gratuity Rule.title: Set up a gratuity rule
Create Gratuity Rule.description: How gratuity is calculated from years of service. See [Gratuity Rule](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/gratuity-rule).

View Income Tax Computation.name: View Income Tax Computation
View Income Tax Computation.title: Check each employee's tax
View Income Tax Computation.description: Taxable income, exemptions and tax for each employee in a payroll period.
View Income Tax Computation.report_description: Taxable income, exemptions and tax for each employee in a payroll period.
